items.title: Pay driving school invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweise den Gesamtbetrag binnen 7 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto bei der Musterbank AG (siehe unten).
items.computation: The invoice is dated 08.09.2025 (Monday); this is the event that starts the period. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts 09.09.2025. The period is 7 days: 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 September 2025 → the 7th day is 15.09.2025 (Monday). This is a payment to a private company, so under § 270 Abs. 4 / § 269 BGB the payer's own Land (NW) holiday rules would apply if the last day fell on a weekend or holiday (§ 193 BGB); 15.09.2025 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift is needed.
